title: Working with MySQL Through an ORM — practice
prompt: A team is preparing to integrate or change a database-backed service. You are working on “Working with MySQL Through an ORM”. Which practice is the strongest next step?
objective: Apply working with mysql through an orm in a controlled MySQL workflow.
target_skills: Working with MySQL Through an ORM

options: Skip testing, assume every SQL engine behaves identically, and apply the change directly to production.
Concatenate untrusted input into SQL text and grant administrator privileges to every application user.

Write a parameterized query using the target driver, keep credentials in environment configuration, and specify error/cleanup behavior.

expected_output: Write a parameterized query using the target driver, keep credentials in environment configuration, and specify error/cleanup behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Select an approach that addresses the stated topic rather than bypassing checks.

hints: Start with the smallest repeatable example or inspection step.
